notes: This contract records the official C++ API used by a bounded fixture witness for IEEE 1516.1-2025 §1.4.1. Two federates publish and subscribe to the two attributes declared by the supplied multi-attribute FOM; the producer updates both values and the observer checks the reflected handles and bytes. The API cannot inspect application-private state, so the scenario does not establish universal FOM completeness or conformance.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object publication, subscription, registration, and Update Attribute Values services with FederateAmbassador discovery and Reflect Attribute Values callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador object-attribute declaration/update and FederateAmbassador discovery/reflection declarations
